expectedIssues: Restaurant cover image failed to load
reportedIssues: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a grey box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo. The image failed to load, so the card looks broken and is less appealing next to the neighbouring pizza card, which has a loaded image.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the time badge ('15–25 min') on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps and covers part of the plate image, and it sits close to the left edge. The badge placement looks slightly inconsistent with the image composition.

The secondary grey text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', the search placeholder) and the greyed inactive tab labels have relatively low contrast against the white and light-grey backgrounds. The grey heart icon over the grey placeholder is also hard to see.
